feature.label: Plagx Writing Companion
feature.description: Free academic writing checks for Markdown, text and LaTeX files: citations and reference lists, BibTeX files, word limits, basic grammar and punctuation suggestions, and writing readiness. All checks run locally. By Plagiarism Checker X. This free plugin does not detect plagiarism or AI-generated text.
